The selection holds 100 tuning stays: 49 with insulin and norepinephrine (with arterial readings), 25 with norepinephrine only (with arterial readings) and 26 with insulin only.

Now I'll run the evaluation rollout with the original model on them. I'll look at three things:
- the format, especially how qualifying stay-hours are defined and how they are averaged;
- the model's current readouts;
- how far those are from my g-estimated truth (insulin x2 should be clearly negative, roughly −10 mg/dL or more; norepinephrine x2 positive, a few mmHg).

A model readout with the wrong sign or near zero would confirm that the model learned confounded associations rather than drug effects.
